overview.description: The GraniteShares 2x Short SpaceX Daily ETF (SNK) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in communication services equity. The fund provides 2x inverse leveraged exposure, less fees and expenses, to daily price movement for shares of Space Exploration Technologies Corp, (NASDAQ: SPCX) stock. SNK was launched on Jun 15, 2026 and is issued by GraniteShares.
